description: Pittston, PA – Congressman Rob Bresnahan today announced the National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB) has endorsed his reelection campaign for Pennsylvania’s 8th Congressional District. The endorsement highlights his record in Congress of delivering wins for Main Street and small businesses in Northeastern Pennsylvania.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Bresnahan Campaign Announces NFIB Endorsement - Rob for PA
